items.text: Service
Opportunity analysis with clear numbers: purchase, renovation, rental and returns.
We don't promise returns: we put the numbers on the table.
We analyse residential investment opportunities with clear information so you can decide with confidence. We also tell you when a deal doesn't make sense for you.
What we analyse
An investment viewed from every angle
01Purchase price and costsPrice, taxes, notary, Land Registry and agent fees: the real cost of entry.
02RenovationWhat works it needs, how much they cost and how much value they add.
03Expected rental incomeCurrent rent for similar properties in the area.
04Estimated returnGross and net, with costs, taxes and void periods.
05RisksBuilding condition, rental regulations and area liquidity.
06Exit strategyWhat happens if you want to sell in a few years.
How we do it
Step by step
